product.ta-walkstation-386sx.summary: The Walkstation 386SX combined a compact notebook with an expansion dock.
product.ta-walkstation-386sx.history: The 386SX was the top compact notebook in the 1991 range, developed by Triumph-Adler for Olivetti and manufactured in Nuremberg. ISER identifies its example with the Olivetti Notebook S20.
product.ta-walkstation-386sx.technical.c: The dock connected a keyboard and mouse. ISER documents a 20 MHz 386SX and 1 MiB expandable to 5 MiB. Computerwoche distinguishes this compact notebook from the System SX20 with its detachable keyboard.
product.ta-walkstation-386sx.technical.v: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-walkstation-386sx.technical.l: A ROM matches the hash in MAME’s preliminary entry. It still needs matching to an identified board, and two microcontroller firmwares are missing. MAME uses a generic 16 MHz AT profile.
product.ta-walkstation-386sx.technical.m: Computerwoche · Neue Portables werden in Nürnberg hergestellt · 15 March 1991
